ticket.summary: Multi-Chat / Multi-Thread: View List of Chat Sessions
ticket.description:
**Story:**
As a Seller Copilot User, I want to view a list of my chat sessions in a left-hand navigation panel.

**Description:**
When a user opens the Seller Copilot interface, a sidebar shows a chronological list of chat sessions.

**Case 1:** User already has an active chat prior to this feature
* Chat name should be created behind the scene using the first question - trimmed question
* When they access chat history only one recent chat and that highlighted as active.

**Case 2:** First time user or old chat session is deleted
* By default user lands in New chat.
* In history pane, it shows an empty state with an option to start a new chat.

Good to have: On posting a follow up question, the chat should move up the list immediately.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
* The left-hand navigation panel is visible by default when the Copilot interface is opened.
* The panel displays a list of chat sessions, each showing its name and last activity.
* The current active chat session is visually highlighted in the list.
* The chat session list is responsive on various mobile screen sizes.

**Grooming notes:**
* Upon rename, the chat should move to the top of the list.
* Pagination of chat list (~20).
* On hover, full chat name should be visible.

**Mobile UI**
* On click of hamburger icon, mobile sends an open.sidebar event.
